lines.zh: 我往前走，脚底几乎没有声音。
lines.en: I come forward with almost no sound.

lines.zh: 我这身骨架走起来很轻。
lines.en: This skeletal frame of mine moves lightly.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压过来，不急。
lines.en: I press in step by step, unhurried.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里走出来，又走回阴影。
lines.en: I step out of the shadow and back into it.

lines.zh: 我的爪子刮过地面，留下浅痕。
lines.en: My claws scrape the ground, leaving light marks.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，没打算先出手。
lines.en: I circle you, not meaning to strike first.
I move so lightly it seems I drift.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙走，尽量不显眼。
lines.en: I keep to the wall, trying not to stand out.

lines.zh: 我跨过一道沟，落地没声。
lines.en: I step over a ditch and land silently.

lines.zh: 我抬头走路，眼睛一直朝前。
lines.en: I walk with my head up, eyes fixed ahead.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后划了一下。
lines.en: My tail cuts once behind me.
I am looking for the light in this place.

lines.zh: 我站着，嘴角一直往上翘。
lines.en: I stand with the corners of my mouth turned up.
I am scenting the light in the air.
I am more at ease in the dark.
I tilt my head, listening.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看了看自己的指甲。
lines.en: I raise a hand and look at my nails.
There is too little brightness around here.
I turn slowly, looking at no one.
I am waiting for you to bring out your light.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸几乎没有声音。
lines.en: My breathing is nearly silent.
I tuck my hands into my robe.

lines.zh: 这里太安静，安静得发闷。
lines.en: It is so quiet here it feels stifling.
I wonder which of you is brighter.
I stare at you and smile.
I can see the light in you.
I shift forward an inch.
Say something; let me hear you.

lines.zh: 我不急，我等你自己亮起来。
lines.en: I am patient; I will wait for you to glow.
My teeth look very white in the dark.
You step back; I step back too.
That aura on you smells good.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，像在看一件东西。
lines.en: I tilt my head as if studying an object.
In the dark, I eat more.
Do not fear; I will not eat you just yet.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，把脸凑到你面前。
lines.en: I bend down and bring my face close.
You will do very nicely.
The brighter you are, the happier I get.
I have no taste for things too dim.
Why did you stop smiling?
I am only looking; I will not strike.
I laugh once and give half a step.
I grin and lick the blood from my lip.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，眼里还是笑着的。
lines.en: I raise my head, still smiling.
I pressed the wound for less than a breath.
I have not tasted pain in a long while.
I square myself up.
I roll my neck and it clicks.
That only makes me want you more.
I do not eat that; I want light.
What you hold is far too dim.
Food does nothing for me.

lines.zh: 你举高一点，让我看看亮不亮。
lines.en: Hold it higher and let me see if it shines.
I do not want this thing.

lines.zh: 把你自己点亮，比这些强。
lines.en: Light yourself up; that is better than this.
That taste is far too faint.
I turn my face toward the dark.
Food is for the weak.
You should put it away.
You crash into me and I do not sway.

lines.zh: 我旋身避开，翼风卷起尘土。
lines.en: I twist aside, my wings whipping up dust.
My frame is hard; that does not hurt.
I push you back with one hand.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，气息乱了。
lines.en: When you pull back, your breathing is ragged.
That is far too light.
I look down at you and my smile widens.
I am not a stone, you know.
Touch me once and you will learn.
I keep to the wall and do not give way.
I have no such need.
I forgot such things long ago.
I laugh once, oddly.
I turned and walked off.
That is not to my appetite.

lines.zh: 我只对亮的东西感兴趣。
lines.en: I am interested only in bright things.
Do not ask me that.
I raise a hand and wave it.
You would not want that answer.
I look elsewhere.
I pinch it up and hold it to my eye.
Too dim; no use.
I threw it away casually.
This one catches light; I will take it.
I flick it up with a nail.
I hold it up to the light.
Useless, and it ties up a hand.
This thing shines; interesting.

lines.zh: 我把它咬了一下，咬不动。
lines.en: I bite it; it does not give.
I raise my head and my eyes light.
Good; you have delivered yourself.
I open my mouth and all my teeth show.
That light is mine.
I threw my whole body forward.

lines.zh: 你的气已经不属于你了。
lines.en: That aura of yours no longer belongs to you.
I could not keep from laughing.

lines.zh: 我算好了距离，一步就到。
lines.en: I have the distance; one step reaches you.
I do not intend to let you go.

lines.zh: 你亮起来的那一下，正好。
lines.en: That flare of yours came at the right moment.

lines.zh: 我这身子一低头，就能吞下整间屋。
lines.en: One dip of this body swallows a whole room.
You brought this on yourself.
My fingers curl tight.
I smell the fear on you.
Nicely prepared; a pity.
This bite will go deep.
I follow you, smiling all the while.
You change direction; so do I.
I am not fast, but I never stop.
Your light is getting closer.

lines.zh: 我贴在阴影里，等你转身。
lines.en: I keep to the shadow and wait for you to turn.
I raise a hand against the glare.
The brighter you get, the hungrier I am.
This road leads nowhere.
I am blocking behind you.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上拖出声音。
lines.en: My claws drag audibly on the ground.
I stay at the edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面飞，爪子拖出火星。
lines.en: I skim the ground, claws striking sparks.
I press you toward the dark.
I wait for you to burn out.

lines.zh: 再坚持一会儿，就有意思了。
lines.en: Last a little longer; it will be interesting.
I do not mind chasing all night.
I hover and watch you veer off course.
I pounce and bite down.
My claws open your shoulder.
I seize you and bring my head close.

lines.zh: 这一口，我吸走了一点光。
lines.en: With that bite I drew off some light.

lines.zh: 亚康的巴掌把你按进碎石。
lines.en: Yakon's palm presses you into the rubble.
My teeth are long, and cold.
I bite, step back, and smile.
You are still glowing; good.

lines.zh: 我抬手一抓，抓住你的手腕。
lines.en: I reach and catch your wrist.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，下一口才重。
lines.en: That was light; the next bite will not be.

lines.zh: 我张嘴的时候，你听见关节响。
lines.en: When I open my mouth, you hear the joint click.
I will not let you draw breath.
I lick what came away.

lines.zh: 我一爪扫过，你撞上石壁。
lines.en: I sweep one claw and you hit the stone wall.
I want more.
This time I want the whole of you.

lines.zh: 黑暗里先是笑了一声，然后是我。
lines.en: A laugh in the dark first; then me.
I step out of the shadow.
My eyes light first.

lines.zh: 这一带的光，忽然都被压暗了。
lines.en: The light here suddenly dims.
I smell something new.
I come down without raising dust.
I lift my head and my teeth are very white.

lines.zh: 我笑着，看着你们每一个。
lines.en: I smile at each of you in turn.
The air has suddenly gone colder.
I come around the pillar.
I settle and smooth my robe.
This night is still long.
I sniff and pick one.

lines.zh: 我走过来，没有加快脚步。
lines.en: I come on without quickening my pace.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被打扰，所以来了。
lines.en: I dislike being disturbed, so here I am.
I stop three paces off and wait.

lines.zh: 你们谁先亮起来，都一样。
lines.en: Whichever of you lights up first, it makes no difference.

lines.zh: 火光烫得我后退，我讨厌亮的东西。
lines.en: The fire's heat drives me back; I hate bright things.

lines.zh: 我落地时腿一软，差点跪下。
lines.en: My legs buckle on landing; I nearly kneel.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我抓着岸边往上爬。
lines.en: Water pours in; I claw up onto the bank.
The blast flash sears my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 有东西钉进我的肋，我低头去拔。
lines.en: Something sticks in my ribs; I bend to pull it out.

lines.zh: 一股光缠住我，我难受得很。
lines.en: Some light binds me, and it is unbearable.

lines.zh: 我饿得发虚，光也吸不到了。
lines.en: Hunger hollows me; I cannot even draw light.

lines.zh: 白光砸下来，我整条手臂都麻了。
lines.en: White lightning hits and my whole arm goes numb.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我抓不到任何东西。
lines.en: Nothing is under me and there is nothing to grip.
